steps.title: GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY
steps.content:
## Группировка

`HAVING` фильтрует **группы**. `ORDER BY` после `GROUP BY`. Для «ровно один раз» — `HAVING COUNT(*) = 1`.

content.caption: HAVING — WHERE для групп
content.description: Сначала GROUP BY, затем HAVING и ORDER BY.

steps.title: 2356. Number of Unique Subjects Taught by Each Teacher

content.description:
Для каждого `teacher_id` — число **разных** `subject` (`count`); без предметов — не выводить.

[LeetCode 2356](https://leetcode.com/problems/number-of-unique-subjects-taught-by-each-teacher/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Teacher(teacher_id INTEGER NOT NULL, subject TEXT NOT NULL, dept TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT teacher_id, COUNT(subject) AS count FROM Teacher GROUP BY teacher_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT teacher_id, COUNT(DISTINCT subject) AS count FROM Teacher GROUP BY teacher_id;

steps.title: 1141. User Activity for the Past 30 Days I

content.description:
По каждой дате `activity_day`: число **уникальных** `user_id` с активностью. Только даты в пределах 30 дней до «2019-07-27» (включительно).

[LeetCode 1141](https://leetcode.com/problems/user-activity-for-the-past-30-days-i/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Activity(user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, session_id INTEGER NOT NULL, activity_date TEXT NOT NULL, activity_type TEXT NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT activity_date AS day, COUNT(user_id) AS active_users FROM Activity GROUP BY activity_date;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT activity_date AS day, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users FROM Activity WHERE activity_date BETWEEN DATE("2019-07-27", "-29 days") AND "2019-07-27" GROUP BY activity_date ORDER BY day;

content.description:
Первый и последний год продаж каждого `product_id` (`first_year`, `last_year`) — только товары, продававшиеся **≥ 2 разных** года.

[LeetCode 1070](https://leetcode.com/problems/product-sales-analysis-iii/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Sales(sale_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product_id INTEGER NOT NULL, year INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT product_id, MIN(year), MAX(year) FROM Sales GROUP BY product_id;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT product_id, MIN(year) AS first_year, MAX(year) AS last_year FROM Sales GROUP BY product_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT year) >= 2;

content.setup: CREATE TABLE Courses(student TEXT NOT NULL, class TEXT NOT NULL);
content.referenceSolution: SELECT class FROM Courses GROUP BY class HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT student) >= 5;

content.description:
Для каждого `user_id` — `followers_count` (число подписчиков). Сортировка: `user_id` по возрастанию.

[LeetCode 1729](https://leetcode.com/problems/find-followers-count/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE Followers(user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, follower_id INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT user_id, COUNT(follower_id) AS followers_count FROM Followers GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY user_id DESC;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT user_id, COUNT(follower_id) AS followers_count FROM Followers GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY user_id;

content.description:
Число, которое встречается **ровно один раз** и больше всех таких; если нет — `NULL` (колонка `num`).

[LeetCode 619](https://leetcode.com/problems/biggest-single-number/)
content.setup: CREATE TABLE MyNumbers(num INTEGER NOT NULL);
content.starterCode: SELECT MAX(num) AS num FROM MyNumbers;
content.referenceSolution: SELECT MAX(num) AS num FROM (SELECT num FROM MyNumbers GROUP BY num HAVING COUNT(*) = 1);

content.description:
Клиенты, купившие **все** продукты из каталога `Product`. Колонка `customer_id`.

[LeetCode 1045](https://leetcode.com/problems/customers-who-bought-all-products/)
content.setup:
CREATE TABLE Customer(customer_id INTEGER NOT NULL, product_key INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE Product(product_key INTEGER PRIMARY KEY);
content.referenceSolution: SELECT customer_id FROM Customer GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_key) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Product);
